itineraries.title: Five days around Menorca
itineraries.intro: The calas of the south and the great harbour of Mahón.

days.note: One of the great natural harbours; the town above it and its gin distillery.
A narrow inlet on the north coast; a quiet night before returning south.
The bay and the lobster stew.
The old capital, its narrow harbour and the coves along the south coast.
Macarella and Turqueta; disembark in Mahón.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Palma to Menorca
itineraries.intro: Mallorca’s north coast, then Menorca’s calas and Mahón.

days.note: The cathedral, the old quarter and dinner in Santa Catalina before sailing.
The tram to Sóller through the orange groves; the horseshoe harbour at night.
The wide bay and Formentor’s cliffs; a swim at Cala Figuera.
The old capital, its narrow harbour and the coves along the south coast.
The turquoise calas of the south.
The long sheltered bay, known for its lobster stew, and the beaches to the west.
